dedupe_keys.name: fogo island cape verde landfill site selection data and nsga ii optimisation inputs

description: This package holds the maps and criteria used to choose where a new landfill could go on Fogo, a volcanic island in Cape Verde where flat, safe and accessible land is scarce. The producers are Julio Leite Azancort Neto, Evelin Helena Silva Cardoso and colleagues linked to the Federal University of Pará, whose paper on multi-objective landfill siting with the NSGA-II genetic algorithm was submitted to IEEE Access. Coverage is the whole island, with shapefiles of geology, protected areas, roads, towns, streams and administrative boundaries, elevation rasters for slope and aspect, and a table of criteria scores for 524 candidate sites. The Python optimisation and GIS code is on GitHub, and the large spatial files are available as a free download from Zenodo under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: the paper was under review when read, criteria weights reflect the authors' choices, and volcanic hazard is represented only through geology layers. Simulation uses: testing landfill and transfer station siting methods, and reusing island base layers for waste collection or emergency planning on small islands. Related records: the EA historic landfill sites (data-ea-historic-landfill-sites) and Ontario landfills (data-ontario-landfills) are inventories of existing sites.
